# Town of Walden municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 24; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Jonathan Augeri, Brenda Huntoon, and Randolph Wilson for Walden's three-member board
Town of Walden, Selectboard page (waldenvt.gov): Randolph Wilson (Chair), Brenda Huntoon, and Jon Augeri
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Deborah Messier as Walden's Town Clerk

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names the clerk as 'Debbie Messier,' a diminutive; the town's own site gives Deborah Messier, which governs
Town of Walden, Boards and Commissions page (waldenvt.gov): 'Walden Town Clerk, Deborah Messier'
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Deborah Messier as Walden's Town Treasurer (the treasurer contact spreadsheet carries no Walden row)
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Walden, Listers page (waldenvt.gov): 'The Board of Listers is a three-member elected board... Members are elected for staggered three-year terms': Victoria Atwood, Dia Michaud, and Emily Varvir
Town of Walden, Auditors page (waldenvt.gov): 'The job of the elected auditors is to review the accounts of local officials': Marie Blodgett, Judy Clifford, and Emily Varvir
Town of Walden, Cemetery page (waldenvt.gov): 'Cemetery Commissioners': Judith Clifford, Lynette Farnham, and Daniel Mencucci (the Auditors page styles Clifford as Judy; one person holds both seats)
Town of Walden, Library page (waldenvt.gov): 'Library Trustees': Sarah Augeri, Martha Bissell, Marie Blodgett, Allison Gulka, and Tammy Hall
